name: Godfrey Mars
source:
Affiliation: Mars Tech (CEO)
Location: The Atheneum, Titan
Relationship: None
Personnel File: Godfrey Mars is one of the top 5 wealthiest Terrans, and probably top 20 in council space. Mars Tech is headquartered on Titan, and probably has more sway on the moon than the Solar Alliance.
Strengths: Instinctual, Intelligent, Ruthless, Secretive, Respected, Wealthy, Leadership, Cautious.
Weaknesses: Ambitious, Arrogant, Cautious to a fault, Leveraged, Many enemies.
Note inserted in file: Active figure under USF Military Surveillance
